currentSummary: M14.10 qualifies private Windows app bundles, durable installation ownership, MSI maintenance and selected native i386 helpers. The native two-app test preserves the migrated neighboring bundle through update, repair, removal and cold restarts. The exact ISO was installed and cold-started in QEMU and VMware. Qualified bundles use private registries and separate dependency copies in private Windows processes without an embedded Windows guest. The browser can download the original Firefox installer. Firefox installation and execution are not supported yet. The M14.9-M14.16 plan continues with private runtimes and services. Final integrated optimization is M14.16. Standalone Windows x86 support remains planned for M15.
